race.comment: ECO EXPRESS (2) resumes as the one to beat despite a wide draw, with the Sandown-Lakeside run better than ninth reads after racing wide throughout in mid-week company. He has trialled second at Oakbank, meets an easier setting and looks capable of improving sharply for the new stable. SNOBZ (4) is race fit and rates strongly on time, with Rochelle Milnes a notable booking as the top-ranked jockey for wins at this track. His Balaklava runs have tapered late, but blinkers come off and this is a winnable Mdn if he sustains his effort. I AM OLE (3) resumes off a solid third in a Port Lincoln trial and his fifth to Elegant Lilly at Balaklava reads well enough for this. HERE SHE IS (6) finds a suitable race on resumption and should be fitter for a recent trial. ALABAMA AWARD (5) gets the blinkers on again today and can run up to his best on resumption.
